zin_realm_accept_match = {
	# G7, scope: the house that accepts (zin_realm.60). The two houses become kin (zin_realm_match on each, opinion +25 both ways).
	hidden_effect = {
		event_target:zin_realm_suitor = {
			set_variable = { zin_realm_match = PREV }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_royal_match }
			PREV = { set_variable = { zin_realm_match = PREV } }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_realm_suitor modifier = zin_realm_royal_match }
	}
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_match_answer
	event_target:zin_realm_suitor = { country_event = { id = zin_realm.61 } }
}
zin_realm_accept_terms = {
	# G6, scope: the realm that accepts (zin_realm.40). The war ends between the two; the land or the silver changes hands; zin_realm.41 tells the offerer.
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_realm_terms_kind = 2 }
				has_event_target = zin_realm_terms_land
			}
			event_target:zin_realm_terms_from = { event_target:zin_realm_terms_land = { transfer_state_to = PREV } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_realm_terms_kind = 3 } }
			event_target:zin_realm_terms_from = { add_political_power = -50 }
			add_political_power = 50
		}
		event_target:zin_realm_terms_from = {
			white_peace = { tag = PREV }
			set_variable = { zin_realm_terms_answer = 1 }
		}
	}
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_terms_to
	event_target:zin_realm_terms_from = { country_event = { id = zin_realm.41 } }
}
zin_realm_age_ruler = {
	# G1: the vigour falls by the people rate, more at war and more again when the war goes badly; at the floor the ruler dies, and below the
	# frail line the ruler may die any month (mtth zin_realm_frail_death, in hundredths).
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_wear = zin_ruler_rate }
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_t_wear = constant:zin_realm.war_wear }
		if = { limit = { surrender_progress > 0.3 } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_t_wear = constant:zin_realm.losing_wear } }
	}
	subtract_from_variable = { zin_ruler_vigour = zin_t_wear }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_ruler_vigour min = 0 max = constant:zin_realm.vigour_max }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_floor = constant:zin_realm.vigour_floor }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_frail = constant:zin_realm.vigour_frail }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_ruler_vigour < zin_t_floor } }
		zin_realm_succeed = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_ruler_vigour < zin_t_frail } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_chance = mtth:zin_realm_frail_death }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = zin_t_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_t_roll < zin_t_chance } } zin_realm_succeed = yes }
	}
}

zin_realm_answer_raid = {
	# G8, scope: the raided realm (zin_realm.70). Argument zin_arg_way: 1 ride out after them (a cause of war for a year), 2 pay them,
	# 3 bar the gates (the raided idea for half a year). zin_realm.71 tells the raiders.
	event_target:zin_realm_raider = { set_variable = { zin_realm_raid_answer = zin_arg_way } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 1 } }
		event_target:zin_realm_raider = { PREV = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_realm_cb_raiders scope = PREV days = 365 } } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 2 } }
		add_political_power = -40
		event_target:zin_realm_raider = { add_political_power = 40 }
	}
	else = { add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_realm_raided days = 180 } }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_way
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_raid_victim
	event_target:zin_realm_raider = { country_event = { id = zin_realm.71 } }
}

zin_realm_break_match = {
	# G7: the marriage bond of THIS realm ends on both sides.
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zin_realm_match }
		var:zin_realm_match = {
			clear_variable = zin_realm_match
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_royal_match }
			PREV = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_royal_match } }
		}
		clear_variable = zin_realm_match
	}
}

zin_realm_check_ambition = {
	# G4: an unsettled realm (calm below the line) may breed an ambitious captain (mtth zin_realm_ambition_chance, in hundredths).
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_ambition_cd }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_in_crisis }
			NOT = { has_stability > 0.25 }
			zin_realm_has_captain = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_chance = mtth:zin_realm_ambition_chance }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = zin_t_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_t_roll < zin_t_chance } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_ambition_cd days = 730 }
			zin_realm_mark_captain = yes
			country_event = { id = zin_realm.20 }
		}
	}
}

	# G7: our kin is gone (the bond ends), at war with us (the bond ends), or fighting a defensive war that we have no part in (zin_realm.63).
	if = {

		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_kin_cd }

				any_enemy_country = {
					NOT = { tag = PREV.PREV }
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV.PREV }
					NOT = { is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV }

					NOT = { tag = PREV.PREV }

zin_realm_check_risings = {
	# G5: a rising in a controlled land that is not our core, then its end (quiet again, or the land is no longer ours).
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zin_realm_rising_state }
		var:zin_realm_rising_state = { save_event_target_as = zin_realm_rising_place }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zin_realm_rising_state = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV } } }
			set_variable = { zin_realm_rising_way = 2 }
			clear_variable = zin_realm_rising_state
			country_event = { id = zin_realm.32 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zin_realm_rising_state = { resistance < 25 } }
			set_variable = { zin_realm_rising_way = 1 }
			clear_variable = zin_realm_rising_state
			country_event = { id = zin_realm.32 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_rising_cd }
			any_controlled_state = {
				resistance > 50
				NOT = { is_core_of = PREV }
			}
		}
		random_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				resistance > 50
				NOT = { is_core_of = PREV }
			}
			save_event_target_as = zin_realm_rising_place
			PREV = { set_variable = { zin_realm_rising_state = PREV } }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_rising_cd days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.31 }
	}
}
zin_realm_check_subject = {
	# G5: a subject that thinks little of its overlord stirs while the overlord is at war.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_subject_cd }
			NOT = { zin_realm_bond_owned = yes }
			OVERLORD = {
				has_war = yes
				PREV = { NOT = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > -25 } } }
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_subject_cd days = 730 }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.30 }
	}
}
zin_realm_check_war = {
	# G6: a war month. An AI realm offers terms a year into a war that no story owner ends; an AI realm makes peace in a war it cannot
	# fight (no border with the foe for a year and a half), and with any court of the East once the false god is dead.
	add_to_variable = { zin_realm_war_months = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_terms = constant:zin_realm.terms_war_months }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_purpose = constant:zin_realm.purpose_war_months }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { zin_realm_story_war_side = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_terms_cd }
			NOT = { check_variable = { zin_realm_war_months < zin_t_terms } }
			any_enemy_country = { NOT = { zin_realm_story_war_side = yes } }
		}
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { NOT = { zin_realm_story_war_side = yes } }
			save_event_target_as = zin_realm_terms_to
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_terms_cd days = 180 }
		zin_realm_offer_terms = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_purpose_cd }
			any_enemy_country = { zin_realm_pointless_war = yes }
		}
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { zin_realm_pointless_war = yes }
			save_event_target_as = zin_realm_pointless_foe
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_purpose_cd days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.42 }
	}
}
zin_realm_contest_crown = {
	# G3: the claimant the council would not have raises a banner: a civil war of the same allegiance (ruling_party keeps the crown's own party).
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_realm_contested_crowns = 1 }
	set_country_flag = zin_realm_crown_contested
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = democratic }
		start_civil_war = {
			ideology = democratic
			ruling_party = democratic
			size = 0.35
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_government = fascism }
		start_civil_war = {
			ideology = fascism
			ruling_party = fascism
			size = 0.35
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_government = communism }
		start_civil_war = {
			ideology = communism
			ruling_party = communism
			size = 0.35
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_government = neutrality }
		start_civil_war = {
			ideology = neutrality
			ruling_party = neutrality
			size = 0.35
		}
	}
}

	# G7 (zin_realm.63): we do not answer; the kin take it ill and the bond ends.

zin_realm_found_exile_court = {
	# G9: the court of THIS fallen realm (its ruler lives) looks for a shelter: an ally still in the field, the house it married into, a
	# neighbour, or any realm that thinks well of it, never the conqueror (event_target:zin_realm_conqueror, saved by the caller). zin_realm.50 to the shelter.
	if = {
		limit = { zin_realm_court_may_flee = yes }
		save_event_target_as = zin_realm_fallen
		set_country_flag = zin_realm_court_in_exile
		if = {
			limit = { any_country = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
					is_in_faction_with = PREV
				} }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
					is_in_faction_with = PREV
				}
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zin_realm_match
				var:zin_realm_match = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
				}
			}
			var:zin_realm_match = { zin_realm_take_in_court = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_neighbor_country = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
				} }
			random_neighbor_country = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
				}
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_country = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
					has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 49 }
				} }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = PREV }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:zin_realm_conqueror }
					NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
					has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 49 }
				}
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = zin_realm_court_dispersed }
	}
}
zin_realm_house_golden_king = {
	# G9 for the Golden King (SL-25, owner question Q-65 default: he keeps a court in exile that can return): once zin_golden_king_exiled is
	# set, his court goes to the first shelter of data/realm_life.json that still stands, has not capitulated, does not hold Parim and is not
	# the Deliverer's seat. zin_realm.50 to the shelter.
	set_global_flag = zin_realm_gk_court
	AEN = {
		save_event_target_as = zin_realm_fallen
		set_country_flag = zin_realm_court_in_exile
		if = {
			limit = {
				LER = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			LER = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				SEL = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			SEL = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				KIN = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			KIN = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				KON = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			KON = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				HNH = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			HNH = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				HER = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			HER = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOL = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			NOL = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ORH = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			ORH = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				KUN = {
					exists = yes
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { owns_state = 238 }
					NOT = { original_tag = WOR }
					NOT = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
			}
			KUN = {
				set_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				zin_realm_take_in_court = yes
			}
		}
		else = { set_global_flag = zin_realm_gk_court_dispersed }
	}
}
zin_realm_join_kin = {
	# G7 (zin_realm.63): we join the war of our kin.
	event_target:zin_realm_kin = {
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_kin_answered }
		PREV = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = PREV enemy = event_target:zin_realm_kin_foe hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
	}
}
zin_realm_keep_bond = {
	# G5: the subject keeps faith.
	OVERLORD = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_kept_faith } }
}
zin_realm_keep_exile_court = {
	# G9, scope: the shelter keeps the court of event_target:zin_realm_fallen: the court idea, the fallen court's thanks, and claims on the lands
	# of the fallen realm that others hold.
	add_ideas = zin_realm_exiled_court
	hidden_effect = {
		event_target:zin_realm_fallen = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_sheltered_us }
			every_core_state = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_owned_by = PREV }
					NOT = { is_owned_by = PREV.PREV }
				}
				add_claim_by = PREV.PREV
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_realm_loosen_bond = {
	# G5: the subject wins a looser bond.
	add_autonomy_ratio = { value = 0.2 localization = zin_realm_autonomy_tt }
	OVERLORD = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_demanded_autonomy } }
}
zin_realm_mark_captain = {
	# G3, G4: the ablest captain-general of THIS realm becomes the ambitious one (character flag zin_char_ambitious).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { any_army_leader = { has_character_flag = zin_char_ambitious } } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_army_leader = { skill > 2 } }
			random_army_leader = { limit = { skill > 2 } set_character_flag = zin_char_ambitious }
		}
		else = { random_army_leader = { set_character_flag = zin_char_ambitious } }
	}
}
zin_realm_note_ruler = {
	# G1: a ruler the pulse has not seen (a successor of any kind, a usurper, a ruler a focus or a story owner raised) gets a fresh vigour,
	# and, when the start variety is not off, a temper (zin_variety_temper_new_ruler).
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_new = 0 }
	random_character = {
		limit = {
			is_country_leader = yes
			NOT = { has_character_flag = zin_realm_known }
		}
		set_character_flag = zin_realm_known
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_new = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_t_new = 1 }
				NOT = { has_variable = zin_ruler_vigour }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = zin_t_v min = 60 max = 100 integer = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_ruler_vigour = zin_t_v }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zin_ruler_rate } } set_variable = { zin_ruler_rate = constant:zin_realm.rate_default } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_t_new = 1 }
				NOT = { zin_realm_is_story_ruler = yes }
			}
			zin_variety_temper_new_ruler = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_realm_offer_terms = {
	# G6: THIS realm offers terms to event_target:zin_realm_terms_to. Kind 1 peace on the old borders; kind 2 the land our hosts hold of theirs
	# that we claim (when they are losing and we are not); kind 3 silver for peace (when we are losing). Fires zin_realm.40.
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_terms_from
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_kind = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			event_target:zin_realm_terms_to = { surrender_progress > 0.25 }
			NOT = { surrender_progress > 0.1 }
			any_controlled_state = {
				is_owned_by = event_target:zin_realm_terms_to
				OR = {
					is_core_of = PREV
					is_claimed_by = PREV
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_kind = 2 }
		random_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = event_target:zin_realm_terms_to
				OR = {
					is_core_of = PREV
					is_claimed_by = PREV
				}
			}
			save_event_target_as = zin_realm_terms_land
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			surrender_progress > 0.25
			has_political_power > 49
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_kind = 3 }
	}
	event_target:zin_realm_terms_to = {
		set_variable = { zin_realm_terms_kind = zin_t_kind }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.40 }
	}
}
zin_realm_open_crisis = {
	# G3: No Heir of the Body. The crisis idea lasts until the claimants are settled (a year at most).
	set_country_flag = zin_realm_in_crisis
	add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_realm_crisis days = 365 }
	country_event = { id = zin_realm.12 }
}
zin_realm_pledge_to_kin = {
	# G7 (zin_realm.61): a guarantee of the new kin.
	event_target:zin_realm_match_answer = { PREV = { give_guarantee = PREV } }
}
zin_realm_pulse = {
	# The monthly pulse of one realm (THIS; ROOT is the world runner).
	zin_realm_note_ruler = yes
	if = { limit = { zin_realm_mortal = yes } zin_realm_age_ruler = yes }
	zin_realm_tick_regency = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { zin_rules_is_historical = yes }
			zin_realm_crisis_allowed = yes
		}
		zin_realm_check_ambition = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = yes
			NOT = { zin_rules_is_historical = yes }
		}
		zin_realm_check_subject = yes
	}
	zin_realm_check_risings = yes
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes } zin_realm_check_war = yes }
	else = { set_variable = { zin_realm_war_months = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zin_realm_match } zin_realm_check_kinship = yes }
	if = { limit = { zin_realm_is_raider = yes } zin_realm_check_raid = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zin_realm_exile_court } zin_realm_check_exiles = yes }
}
zin_realm_raid = {
	# G8: THIS realm raids event_target:zin_realm_raid_victim (zin_realm.70 to the victim).
	set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_raid_cd days = 365 }
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_raider
	event_target:zin_realm_raid_victim = {
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_realm_raided_recently days = 365 }
		set_variable = { zin_realm_last_raider = PREV }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_raided_us }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.70 }
	}
}
zin_realm_refuse_exile_court = {
	# G9, scope: the shelter sends the court away; it disperses.
	hidden_effect = {
		clear_variable = zin_realm_exile_court
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court }
			clr_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
			set_global_flag = zin_realm_gk_court_dispersed
		}
		event_target:zin_realm_fallen = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_turned_us_away }
			clr_country_flag = zin_realm_court_in_exile
			set_country_flag = zin_realm_court_dispersed
			clear_variable = zin_realm_sheltered_by
		}
	}
}
zin_realm_refuse_match = {
	# G7, scope: the house that refuses (zin_realm.60); the suitor takes it ill (opinion -15).
	hidden_effect = { event_target:zin_realm_suitor = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_match_refused } } }
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_match_answer
	event_target:zin_realm_suitor = { country_event = { id = zin_realm.62 } }
}
zin_realm_refuse_terms = {
	# G6, scope: the realm that refuses (zin_realm.40).
	hidden_effect = {
		event_target:zin_realm_terms_from = {
			set_variable = { zin_realm_terms_answer = 2 }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_terms_refused }
		}
	}
	save_event_target_as = zin_realm_terms_to
	event_target:zin_realm_terms_from = { country_event = { id = zin_realm.41 } }
}
zin_realm_restore_exiles = {
	# G9, scope: the shelter (zin_realm.51). Argument zin_arg_way: 1 release the fallen realm and set it free, 2 release it as our sworn realm,
	# 3 keep the land (the court disperses), 4 the court goes home to a realm that still stands. The Golden King's restoration sets zin_golden_king_restored.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 1 }
				check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 2 }
			}
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = {
				release = [TAG]
			}
			TAG = "[zin_realm_fallen.GetTag]"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 1 } }
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					end_puppet = [TAG]
				}
				TAG = "[zin_realm_fallen.GetTag]"
			}
		}
		event_target:zin_realm_fallen = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_restored_us } }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
				NOT = { check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 3 } }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_golden_king_restored
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_way = 3 } }
			event_target:zin_realm_fallen = { set_country_flag = zin_realm_court_dispersed }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_realm_exiled_court } remove_ideas = zin_realm_exiled_court }
		clear_variable = zin_realm_exile_court
		clr_country_flag = zin_realm_shelters_golden_court
		event_target:zin_realm_fallen = {
			clr_country_flag = zin_realm_court_in_exile
			clear_variable = zin_realm_sheltered_by
		}
	}
	clear_variable = zin_arg_way
}
zin_realm_run_batch = {
	# One weekly batch: the Golden King's court is housed if it waits, then every country of this batch's slot has its pulse.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_exiled
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_realm_gk_court }
		}
		zin_realm_house_golden_king = yes
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_realm_slot = global.zin_realm_batch } }
		zin_realm_pulse = yes
	}
}
zin_realm_settle_crisis = {
	# G3: the crisis ends. Argument zin_arg_way: 1 the council elects, 2 the claimants fight for it (a contested crown), 3 a prince of the house
	# we married into takes it (a sworn realm of that house when the course of the age is free, its guarantee otherwise), 4 the captain-general
	# takes it, 5 the nearest kinsman is proclaimed. Fires zin_realm.15.
	set_variable = { zin_realm_crisis_way = zin_arg_way }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_way
	if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_realm_crisis } remove_ideas = zin_realm_crisis }
	clr_country_flag = zin_realm_in_crisis
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_realm_crisis_way = 1 } } add_stability = -0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_realm_crisis_way = 2 } } zin_realm_contest_crown = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_realm_crisis_way = 3 } } zin_realm_take_foreign_prince = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_realm_crisis_way = 4 } } zin_realm_mark_captain = yes zin_realm_crown_captain = yes }
	country_event = { id = zin_realm.15 }
}
zin_realm_succeed = {
	# G1 to G3: the ruler of THIS realm has died. A named heir takes the crown (a child through a regency that lasts until the heir is grown,
	# clamped to two to five years); a kinsman named by Name an Heir takes it quietly; a crown that passes by blood or by combat with no heir
	# falls into crisis when it may; a realm that chooses by its own custom chooses; any other realm takes the successor the engine names.
	set_variable = { zin_realm_succession_way = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { zin_realm_has_named_heir = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_age = global.year }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_t_age = constant:zin_realm.count_offset }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_t_age = zin_realm_heir_born }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_adult = constant:zin_realm.adult_age }
		kill_country_leader = yes
		zin_realm_crown_heir = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zin_realm_heir_born
				check_variable = { zin_t_age < zin_t_adult }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_t_days = zin_t_adult }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_t_days = zin_t_age }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_t_days = constant:zin_realm.days_per_year }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_t_days min = constant:zin_realm.regency_min_days max = constant:zin_realm.regency_max_days }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_realm_regency days = zin_t_days }
			set_country_flag = zin_realm_in_regency
			set_variable = { zin_realm_succession_way = 2 }
			country_event = { id = zin_realm.11 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { zin_realm_succession_way = 1 }
			country_event = { id = zin_realm.10 }
		}
		clear_variable = zin_realm_heir_born
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_realm_heir_named }
		clr_country_flag = zin_realm_heir_named
		kill_country_leader = yes
		set_variable = { zin_realm_succession_way = 3 }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				zin_realm_inherits = yes
				zin_realm_contested_custom = yes
			}
			zin_realm_crisis_allowed = yes
		}
		kill_country_leader = yes
		zin_realm_open_crisis = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { zin_realm_inherits = yes }
			NOT = { zin_realm_contested_custom = yes }
			NOT = { zin_realm_open_custom = yes }
		}
		kill_country_leader = yes
		set_variable = { zin_realm_succession_way = 4 }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.10 }
	}
	else = {
		kill_country_leader = yes
		set_variable = { zin_realm_succession_way = 5 }
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.10 }
	}
}
zin_realm_take_foreign_prince = {
	# G3, way 3: a prince of the house we married into takes the crown.
	if = {
		limit = { zin_rules_is_free = yes }
		var:zin_realm_match = { puppet = PREV }
	}
	else = {
		var:zin_realm_match = {
			give_guarantee = PREV
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_realm_kin_answered }
		}
	}
}
zin_realm_take_in_court = {
	# G9, scope: the shelter (PREV is the fallen realm).
	set_variable = { zin_realm_exile_court = PREV }
	PREV = { set_variable = { zin_realm_sheltered_by = PREV } }
	country_event = { id = zin_realm.50 }
}
zin_realm_tick_regency = {
	# G2: the regency idea has run out, so the heir is grown and rules.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_realm_in_regency
			NOT = { has_idea = zin_realm_regency }
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_realm_in_regency
		country_event = { id = zin_realm.14 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_realm_in_crisis
			NOT = { has_idea = zin_realm_crisis }
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_realm_in_crisis
	}
}
zin_story_tick_realm = {
	# Step 9 of the world tick (zin_story_tick, convention C6) on the world runner: batch 0 now, batches 1 to 3 seven, fourteen and twenty-one
	# days on (K34). The runner may change next month; a batch queued on a runner that is annexed meanwhile is lost for that month.
	set_variable = { global.zin_realm_batch = 0 }
	zin_realm_run_batch = yes
	country_event = { id = zin_realm.1 days = 7 }
	country_event = { id = zin_realm.1 days = 14 }
	country_event = { id = zin_realm.1 days = 21 }
}
